papers.title_en: Distributionally Robust Chance-Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Home Energy Management under Electric Vehicle Uncertainty
papers.authors: Meng Yuan, Ye Wang, Yi Mei, Ramesh Rayudu, Alan Brent, Xinghuo Yu, Mengjie Zhang
papers.evidence: 机会约束马尔可夫决策过程与拉格朗日软演员评论家安全约束求解
papers.tldr: 住宅能源电气化与电动汽车普及带来需求侧灵活性，但随机驾驶行为使出发可用性和热舒适难以保障。作者将家庭调度建模为分布鲁棒机会约束马尔可夫决策过程，以2-Wasserstein模糊集抵御尾部风险与分布漂移，并用收紧期望约束、拉格朗日软演员-评论家和在线边界守护求解。惠灵顿一年仿真显示，该方法在满足EV目标与两类机会约束下，年成本较规则基线降低8.6%，舒适违例小时减少69%。
papers.abstract_en: The electrification of residential energy systems and adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) create demand-side flexibility. However, random driving behaviour makes it difficult to ensure EV readiness at departure and maintain thermal comfort. To address this, we formulate residential scheduling as a distributionally robust (DR) chance-constrained Markov decision process, whose 2-Wasserstein ambiguity set guards against tail risk and distribution shift in EV behaviour. The intractable DR chance constraint is then replaced by a sufficient tightened expectation constraint under the nominal distribution. The resulting problem is solved by a Lagrangian soft actor--critic with distributional cost critics, and an online boundary guard enforces EV reachability and thermal comfort within the actuator limits at every step. Five controllers are compared over one year in Wellington, New Zealand, under a degraded forecast. The proposed controller is the cheapest controller that meets the EV target on every day and both chance constraints under forecast error and random driving behaviour. Compared with the rule-based baseline, the only other controller to do so, it lowers the annual cost by 8.6% and the comfort violation hours by 69%. The ablation study confirms that the boundary guard ensures pointwise feasibility within the actuator limits, and the DR chance constraint reduces tail risk.

papers.title_en: SAFTER: Safety-Aware Filtering Through Explicit Recoverability for Robust Reinforcement Learning under Distribution Shift
papers.authors: Benedictus C. G. Cinun, Bin Hu
papers.evidence: 控制屏障函数过滤器与可恢复性，可迁移为离散安全层
papers.tldr: 在有限驱动与分布偏移下，安全策略常因不可恢复动作而失效。SAFTER将可微闭式backup-CBF过滤器嵌入Soft Actor-Critic，把即时安全、有限时域备份安全、终端可恢复性与输入可行性统一为单一证书，并给出最小干预投影。四足导航中训练成功率达90%，样本效率优于SAC与CBF基线；未见环境中较CBF-RL和SEA-Nav最高提升42.4与61.4个百分点，真实地图成功率达73.3%/76.7%。消融显示精确微分安全过滤是鲁棒性关键。
papers.abstract_en: Learning safe policies that generalize to unseen environments is difficult under bounded actuation, where an unsafe decision may become unrecoverable. Conventional control barrier function (CBF) filters enforce only instantaneous safety and ignore future recoverability. We propose SAFTER (Safety-Aware Filtering Through Explicit Recoverability), which embeds a differentiable, closed-form backup-CBF filter into Soft Actor-Critic training. SAFTER unifies current safety, finite-horizon backup safety, terminal recoverability, and input admissibility into a single differentiable certificate. Its CBF condition yields an exact minimum-intervention projection without iterative online optimization. In quadruped navigation, SAFTER reaches 90% training success with 30.6% fewer transitions than Vanilla SAC and 34.1-35.1% fewer than current-state CBF-filtered SAC baselines. Across unseen simulated environments, SAFTER improves success by up to 42.4 and 61.4 percentage points over the state-of-the-art methods CBF-RL and SEA-Nav, respectively, and achieves 73.3% and 76.7% success on two real-world navigation maps. Ablations identify accurate differentiation through the safety filter as a key contributor to robustness, in which replacing the projection Jacobian with the identity approximation reduces success rate in a High-Shift environment from 61.4% to 6.2%. These results show that recoverability-aware filtering serves as both a runtime safety mechanism and a learning mechanism for sample-efficient, robust policies.

papers.title_en: Prescribed Performance Guided Safe Reinforcement Learning for Roundabout Navigation of Autonomous Vehicles
papers.authors: Wenhan Li, Yangrui Zhang, Hang Zhou, Peiran Liu, Yiding Ji
papers.evidence: 带控制障碍函数与严格安全保证的安全强化学习
papers.tldr: 环岛导航面临密集交互与行为不确定性，现有RL-MPC框架存在点式决策与轨迹优化不匹配且缺乏严格安全保证。本文提出RLTrajGen-PPMPC-CBF分层框架，用预设性能约束平滑耦合RL规划与MPC控制，并以CBF层实时安全修正并反馈RL。MetaDrive实验中成功率较最优基线提升6.25%，MSDV降低65.87%，并加速训练收敛。该工作提升了环岛导航的安全性、舒适性与训练效率。
papers.abstract_en: Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) face significant challenges in roundabout navigation due to dense traffic interactions and unpredictable agent behaviors, necessitating high levels of adaptability and safety. While the combination of Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Model Predictive Control (MPC) offers a promising approach, existing frameworks suffer from a structural mismatch where pointwise RL decisions fail to align with MPC's trajectory level optimization, and often lack rigorous safety guarantees. This work proposes RLTrajGen-PPMPC-CBF, a hierarchical framework for safe, smooth and comfort roundabout navigation, which regulates the coupling between RL-based planning and MPC-based control. We employ Prescribed Performance Constraints (PPC) to enforce a gradual, stable convergence between reference trajectories and control outputs, ensuring MPC tracking performance remains consistent with intended behavior from RL. Additionally, a Control Barrier Function (CBF) layer provides real-time safety corrections that are fed back into the RL process. Simulation results in the MetaDrive environment demonstrate that our method achieves a 6.25\% increase in average success rate and a 65.87\% reduction in Motion Sickness Dose Value (MSDV) compared to the optimal baseline, meanwhile accelerating training convergence.

papers.authors: Sebastian Reboul, Lorenzo Croissant, Hélène Halconruy
papers.evidence: 在离散MDP中学习决定状态动作对是否允许的动作掩码
papers.tldr: 在强化学习中，动作掩码（无效状态-动作对）通常需预先已知，但某些应用中确定掩码本身就是主要计算瓶颈。论文在线性MDP下将最优策略搜索与掩码学习结合，假设每次尝试动作可揭示线性有效性得分的精确值。作者先提出基于确定性乐观优化的算法，证明其极小极大最优且计算高效，但指出其在非退化实例上次优。随后提出一种计算高效且主动规划探索的替代算法，可解释为确定性反馈下的信息导向采样类比，并用于无效动作集随时间变化的迁移学习。
papers.abstract_en: In reinforcement learning, one presumes the action set to be known ahead of time, and, thus, one must know if any state-action pairs are not permissible   ahead of computations. In some applications, determining this action mask is the main computational bottleneck. Isolating this problem to highlight its core   properties, we study how to combine the search for an optimal policy with the learning of the mask itself, under a linear MDP model in which each attempted   action reveals the exact value of a linear score determining its validity. In this framework, we first construct an algorithm based on deterministic   optimistic optimization and show that it is minimax optimal, which we show is also computationally efficient. However, it is sub-optimal on non-degenerate   instances, as we show. We propose an alternative, which is also computationally efficient, which plans its exploration strategy. This algorithm admits a   formal interpretation as an analogue of information-directed-sampling for deterministic feedback, which may be of independent interest. Finally, we study an   application of this framework to transfer learning, where the invalid action set changes over time.

papers.title_en: SEVI: Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence: 安全评论家估计约束违反风险并在线覆盖不安全动作
papers.tldr: 真实机器人强化学习在接触丰富操作中易发生不安全交互，阻碍落地。SEVI 引入证据安全评论家，单次前向同时估计未来约束违反风险与认知不确定性，并在执行前对不安全或证据不足的动作进行干预。实验覆盖仿真操作与真实 USB 插入，在分布内和分布偏移下取得最高任务成功率、最低不安全事件数，并较恢复式安全 RL 减少 13.4%–57.1% 不安全事件。其意义在于以低延迟过滤提升真实世界策略学习的安全可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world reinforcement learning has enabled contact-rich manipulation tasks to be trained directly on physical robots, but unsafe interactions during online learning remain a key barrier to practical deployment. We propose Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning (SEVI), a framework for reliability-aware safety intervention during real-world policy learning. SEVI introduces an Evidential Safety Critic that estimates both future constraint-violation risk and epistemic uncertainty in a single forward pass. During online learning, SEVI evaluates each task-policy action before execution; if the action is predicted to be unsafe or the prediction is insufficiently supported by evidence, SEVI overrides it with an offline-trained recovery policy that guides the robot toward a lower-risk region. We evaluate SEVI on two simulated manipulation tasks and a real-world USB insertion task under in-distribution and distribution-shifted conditions. Across task-learning and safety-critic baselines, SEVI achieves the strongest trajectory-level safety prediction, the highest final task success, and the lowest unsafe-event counts. SEVI also reduces unsafe events by 13.4 to 57.1 percent relative to recovery-based safe RL while preserving low-latency execution-time filtering. The project page is available at: https://sevi-safe.github.io/

papers.title_en: Reward Objectives for Robust (PO)MDPs: A Law-Preserving Equivalence with (Partially Observable) Games
papers.authors: Durgam Latha, Dion Reji, Dorde Zikelic, Shankaranarayanan Krishna
papers.evidence: 鲁棒MDP下的CVaR与熵风险度量及阈值判定
papers.tldr: 针对部分可观测且转移概率受对抗扰动的鲁棒MDP，论文研究折扣和、长期平均与累积奖励四类目标下的风险度量求解。作者先形式化涵盖期望、均值方差、CVaR和熵风险的律不变风险度量，再将对偶矩形多面体不确定集上的RPOMDP归约为POSG。通过保策略且保奖励分布（至常数缩放）的对数空间归约证明二者等价，并导出新的复杂度结果。
papers.abstract_en: Robust partially observable Markov decision processes model agents that act under partial observability while adversarial environment resolves uncertainty in the transition probabilities. Reward objectives such as discounted-sum, long-run average and cumulative reward under finite and infinite horizons allow quantifying the utility of an agent. We consider the problem of solving RPOMDPs under all four reward objectives, where the goal is to decide whether the value of a risk measure with respect to a reward objective exceeds a given threshold. We consider different risk measures, such as (1)~expected value, (2)~mean-variance (MV), (3)~conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), and (4)~entropic risk (ERisk). Our results can be summarized as follows. First, we formalize the class of law-invariant risk measures, that subsume all four risk measures above. Second, we propose a unified framework for solving RPOMDPs with discounted-sum, long-run average and cumulative reward objectives under any law-invariant risk measure, by reducing the problem to solving partially observable stochastic games (POSGs). Our unified framework applies to (s,a)-rectangular RPOMDPs with polytopic uncertainty sets, which we show to be {\em equivalent} to POSGs, for each of the four reward objectives and any law-invariant risk measure. We prove equivalence by designing logspace reductions between the RPOMDP and POSG models, that map strategies to strategies and preserve the distribution of the reward objective, up to a constant rescaling factor. Third, as a corollary, we derive new computational complexity results for R(PO)MDPs and POSGs. In particular, we show that solving (s,a)-rectangular RMDPs is as hard as solving simple stochastic games.

papers.authors: Carlos Pérez Octavio Mendoza, Frédéric Godin
papers.evidence: CVaR尾部风险优化与风险敏感强化学习
papers.tldr: 极端风险在强化学习中常因高置信水平下样本稀少而难以估计，CVaR经验估计尤其不稳定。该文将极值理论引入高维神经网络策略的CVaR优化，用超阈值建模与矩估计构造可微尾风险目标，并借助自动微分计算有限样本梯度。在已知最优解的受控实验和罕见极端行情深度对冲任务中，EVT策略在正常条件下与经验CVaR策略表现相近，但在极端情景评估中对冲损失更低。结果表明，极端风险观测稀缺时EVT可作为训练神经策略的实用替代方案。
papers.abstract_en: Estimating extreme risk in reinforcement learning becomes increasingly difficult as the confidence level increases, since only a small number of observations contribute to empirical estimates of Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). In this paper, we extend an Extreme Value Theory (EVT) approach for CVaR optimization to high-dimensional neural-network policies. Using a peaks-over-threshold representation and method-of-moments estimation, we obtain a differentiable tail-risk objective and show that, conditional on the selected threshold, its finite-sample gradient can be computed directly through automatic differentiation. We first validate the approach in a controlled experiment with a known optimal solution and then investigate its performance in a deep-hedging problem with rare extreme market movements. Our results show similar hedging behavior for EVT- and empirical-CVaR-trained policies under normal conditions, while EVT-trained policies exhibit lower hedging losses under the extreme-scenario evaluation across the training sample sizes considered. These results suggest that EVT can provide a practical alternative for training neural policies when the observations relevant to extreme risk are scarce.

papers.title_en: Vulnerability Analysis for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement
papers.authors: Taozheng Zhu, Shixiong Jiang, Fanxin Kong
papers.evidence: 安全多智能体强化学习的安全约束与安全代价界
papers.tldr: 安全多智能体强化学习（SMARL）虽在策略优化中引入安全约束，但其推理时观测攻击脆弱性仍缺乏系统分析。本文提出MinMax Attack，联合为受控智能体选择对抗目标动作，并显式考虑良性智能体的协作抵抗。理论推导安全代价上界，刻画其与受控智能体预算、扰动预算的关系。多基准实验表明该方法显著提高安全代价且保持任务奖励，兼具攻击有效性与隐蔽性，为SMARL安全评估提供新视角。
papers.abstract_en: Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (SMARL) aims to learn cooperative control policies under prescribed safety constraints. Al- though existing SMARL methods focus on enforcing safety during policy optimization, their vulnerability remains largely unexplored. This paper investigates inference-time observation attacks against SMARL, where an adversary perturbs the observations of a subset of agents, thereby altering the actions produced by their policies. We propose MinMax Attack, an attack framework that jointly selects adversarial target actions for compromised agents while accounting for the Cooperative Resistance of benign agents. We further derive a bound on the induced safety cost and characterize its relation- ship with the Compromised-Agent Budget and the Perturbation Budget. Experiments across multiple safety-critical multi-agent benchmarks and representative state-of-the-art SMARL algorithms show that MinMax Attack induces substantially higher safety costs than existing attack baselines while preserving task reward, thereby reducing its detectability and achieving both attack effectiveness and stealthiness.

papers.title_en: Enumeration-Guided Training of Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Safety Certificates
papers.authors: Mihaela-Larisa Clement, Tosca Pierro, Ezio Bartocci, Luca Marzari
papers.evidence: 基于Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析的安全证书，为控制系统提供形式化安全保证
papers.tldr: 神经Hamilton-Jacobi安全证书训练常因危险区域难刻画而不准。本文提出枚举引导的验证训练框架，用概率枚举安全约束检测前向不变性违例，生成紧凑反例并微调预训练HJ值函数。实验获得更大认证区域、更短认证时间，并在Isaac Sim与真实自动驾驶竞速中实现零安全约束违反。
papers.abstract_en: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis offers formal safety guarantees for control systems, but training accurate neural certificates remains difficult, particularly when unsafe regions are hard to characterize. We propose a verification-guided training framework that addresses this by using probabilistic enumeration of safety constraints to detect forward-invariance violations, i.e., states where the learned certificate incorrectly classifies unsafe behavior. This produces a compact, targeted set of counterexamples that more precisely captures the failure boundary than inputs generated by standard adversarial attack methods. Crucially, using this representation to fine-tune a pretrained HJ value function yields larger certified regions and reduces certification time across all tested benchmarks. We further introduce a shielding mechanism based on the refined certificates to enforce safety constraints at deployment time. We evaluate the proposed safety filter in a realistic, physics-based Isaac Sim environment and through real-world autonomous racing experiments, achieving zero safety constraint violations compared to a nominal controller and a backup policy based on Linear Quadratic Regulation (LQR). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed shielding mechanism in ensuring safe operation under high-speed, safety-critical conditions.

papers.title_en: Temporal Difference Learning of Probabilistic Reach-Avoid Value Functions
papers.authors: Elias Fontanari, Pietro Noah Crestaz, Matteo Saveriano, Andrea Del Prete
papers.evidence: 可达-避障安全值函数与安全保证
papers.tldr: 传统HJR将扰动视为对抗最坏情况，在随机扰动下易保守且需预知扰动集。本文提出PVF，用自监督时序差分学习黑盒系统在随机甚至无界扰动下的概率reach-avoid值函数，以概率阈值定义可达避碰集。在复杂度递增系统至Hopper任务上，PVF所得集合比HJR基线更不保守、更准确。该工作为随机扰动下的任务可行性与安全监测提供了实用概率化工具。
papers.abstract_en: Reach-avoid sets, defining the states from which a task can be completed while avoiding unsafe regions, are fundamental tools for deploying robots in environments subject to disturbances and uncertainty, as well as for runtime task-feasibility monitoring, allowing prediction of whether a state is safe and will lead to successful task completion. Classical Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability (HJR) and its recent neural extensions (e.g., Lipschitz Continuous Reachability Learning, DeepReach) treat disturbances adversarially, computing the reach-avoid set under worst-case disturbances from a bounded set. This guarantees safety but can yield overly conservative sets when disturbances are stochastic rather than adversarial, and additionally requires the disturbance set to be known or specified in advance.   We propose Probabilistic reach-avoid Value Function (PVF), a self-supervised method, applicable to black-box systems, for computing reach-avoid sets as the states with a certain reach-avoid probability under stochastic, potentially unbounded disturbances. We evaluate our approach against HJR-based baselines on systems of increasing complexity, up to a Hopper locomotion task, and show that our probabilistic sets are less conservative and more accurate than adversarial HJR sets when disturbances are non-adversarial.

papers.title_en: Worst-Case Bayesian CVaR Regret Bounds for Episodic Markov Decision Processes
papers.authors: Raghav Bongole, Amirreza Zamani, Tobias J. Oechtering, Mikael Skoglund
papers.evidence: 有限MDP中风险敏感CVaR遗憾上下界匹配
papers.tldr: 针对时间齐次有限时域分幕马尔可夫决策过程，研究先验最坏情形下累积伪遗憾的贝叶斯CVaR风险。利用UCBVI-BF的高概率保证推导先验预测上界，并用三状态MDP与反向KL不等式构造下界。在状态数固定时，上下界对时域、动作数和幕数呈相同多项式依赖，仅在风险水平上相差对数因子。该结果为风险敏感贝叶斯强化学习提供近乎匹配的最坏情形遗憾刻画。
papers.abstract_en: We study the worst-case, over priors, Bayesian conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) of cumulative pseudo-regret in time-homogeneous finite-horizon episodic Markov decision processes. A high-probability guarantee for UCBVI-BF yields a prior-predictive upper bound. A lower bound follows by a three-state MDP and applying a reverse-KL inequality. For a constant number of states, the bounds have the same polynomial dependence on horizon, actions, and episodes, with a logarithmic gap in the risk level.

papers.title_en: A Decade of Learning-Based Control: From Theoretic Foundations to Practical Deployment
papers.authors: Angela P. Schoellig, Matthias A. Müller, Sebastian Trimpe, Melanie N. Zeilinger, Mahathi Anand, Andrea Carron, Oliver Hausdörfer, Victor G. Lopez, Friedrich Solowjow, Haocheng Zhao, Siqi Zhou
papers.evidence: 综述稳定性与安全保证及基于学习的控制方法
papers.tldr: 学习型控制需在机器学习灵活性与控制理论保证之间取得平衡，以构建可靠安全的自主系统。本文作为CDC十年特邀教程综述，先梳理稳定性与安全保证基础，再回顾学习动力学模型和数据驱动策略合成方法。文中归纳强化学习、模仿学习与贝叶斯优化等路线及代表应用，并指出开放挑战。该文提供入门框架、实现示例和资源，推动真实系统可靠部署。
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by ten years of Learning-Based Control Invited Sessions at the IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC), this tutorial paper reviews key advances at the intersection of machine learning and control. We focus on methods that combine the flexibility of machine learning techniques with the structure and theoretical foundations of control to design autonomous systems that are capable, reliable, and safe. We first introduce core notions for establishing stability and safety guarantees, then review approaches that learn dynamics models to improve control under uncertainty, and finally discuss data-driven methods that directly synthesize or learn policies, including reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and Bayesian optimization. We further discuss representative applications and open challenges. The goal is to provide an accessible entry point to the field and to support continued progress toward reliable learning-based control in real-world systems. To support learning and practical exploration, we share implementations and illustrative examples along with our discussion, together with additional resources on our website: https://learning-based-control.github.io/tutorial/.

papers.title_en: Safe World Model for Joint Trajectory and Beamforming Design of Mobile Base Stations
papers.authors: Abdolrasoul Sakhaei Gharagezlou, Zeinab Askari Donbeh, Mehdi Monemi, Matti Latva-aho, Mehdi Rasti
papers.evidence: 带移动与禁入区安全约束的约束马尔可夫决策过程
papers.tldr: 移动基站可通过自适应定位提供灵活覆盖，但轨迹与数字波束成形耦合优化受移动性、禁区和功率约束影响。论文将其建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，并构建基于 SafeDreamer 的世界模型，在潜空间学习动力学并用想象轨迹联合优化策略。仿真显示时间和平均 SINR 较 PPO 与 DQN 基线分别提升约 7% 和 9%，同时样本效率更高、约束满足更可靠。该工作为移动基站长期规划与安全约束下的联合设计提供了有效框架。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile base stations (MBSs), including aerial and ground-based platforms, provide flexible wireless coverage through adaptive positioning. However, jointly optimizing their trajectories and digital beamforming is challenging because movement changes channel conditions and interference, while beamforming determines the resulting signal and interference powers. These coupled decisions also account for how current movements affect future positions and communication performance under mobility and safety constraints. We formulate this problem as a constrained Markov decision process that maximizes the time-averaged sum signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR), subject to mobility, restricted-zone avoidance, and transmit-power constraints. To support long-term planning and reduce the extensive environment interactions required by model-free reinforcement learning, we develop a SafeDreamer-based world model framework that learns latent system dynamics from experience and optimizes a joint trajectory and beamforming policy through imagined trajectories. Feasibility-preserving action mappings and safety cost signals incorporate operational constraints into policy learning. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework improves the time-averaged sum SINR by an average of 7\% and 9\% compared with proximal policy and deep Q-network baselines, respectively, while achieving higher sample efficiency and more reliable constraint satisfaction.
